mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entity_candidate (book_id, entity_type, canonical_name, description, confidence, review_status, origin_source) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{entityType}, #{canonicalName}, #{description}, #{confidence}, #{reviewStatus}, #{originSource})

INSERT INTO entity_mention (entity_candidate_id, paragraph_id, image_id, mention_text, source_type, confidence) VALUES (#{entityCandidateId}, #{paragraphId}, #{imageId}, #{mentionText}, #{sourceType}, #{confidence})
mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id, entity_type, canonical_name, description, confidence, review_status, origin_source, created_at FROM entity_candidate WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY entity_type, canonical_name

SELECT em.id, em.entity_candidate_id, em.paragraph_id, em.image_id, em.mention_text, em.source_type, em.confidence FROM entity_mention em JOIN entity_candidate ec ON ec.id = em.entity_candidate_id WHERE ec.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY em.entity_candidate_id, em.paragraph_id, em.mention_text
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{bookId}
